summary.text: Nels Christianson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 18 (Grand Forks), serving since 2025. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Judiciary and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Christianson works in the railroad industry and holds a BS in business administration from the University of Southern California.
He is vice chair of the interim Child Custody Review Task Force and serves on the interim Judiciary Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Kristin, with three children.
